# COA themes

| COA | Owner | Theme in one sentence | What must differ from the other COA (main effort, axis, domain, phasing, task organization) |
|---|---|---|---|
| COA A | coa-cell-a | Seize Port Calder from the sea at Beach AMBER, then push inland along Route IRON. | Main effort by sea; amphibious first, land second. |
| COA B | coa-cell-b | Cross the Brenn at Ashby Ford and take Port Calder from the land side. | Main effort on land; the sea is a feint. |
